summary: Confirmed reservable. Added 50 A, water, sewer (14 full-hookup Sumac sites), 79 reservable utility sites, pull-throughs, rigs to 108 ft, showers, flush toilets, year-round season, 2027 holiday 3-night minimum, 14-night rule, campitks booking link. Waterfront lead down to lakeview. Fees left as recorded (AWH 2026-10-15).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (lakefront -> lakeview): no utility site is near the water. Sandstone's north end is ~100-120 m from the lake across a road and an open primitive area (lake in view through scattered trees); the marina cove is ~150 m east of Sandstone behind rows of mobile homes/park models with their own docks, which aren't campground sites (not in the booking catalog). The stored evidence ('eastern rows of camp spurs ~20-40 m from the marina cove shoreline') looks like it read those trailer rows as campsites. Yucca, Cottonwood, Sumac and Switchgrass are 150 m+ from any shore, and the booking site tags no utility site with a lake view or water proximity. Only primitive tent pads and cabins carry 'River/Lake View: Y'.

Count conflict: the booking catalog lists 79 utility sites (14 full hookup, 65 W/E); KDWP's table says 16 full, 50 W/E, 21 electric-only (87). Recorded the catalog's 79; the 21 electric-only sites, if they exist, are not online and would be first-come.

Reservation season conflict on KDWP's reservation page (Apr 1-Sep 30 reservable / Oct-Mar FCFS, versus 'offseason ... online reservations must be made at least five days in advance' and '364 days in advance'): kept the note's line; no booking.season written.
